extension.summary: Play your RomM library with Kodi's built-in emulators
extension.description: Browse the ROM library of a self-hosted RomM server, download games and BIOS files on demand, and play them in Kodi's RetroPlayer using the installed libretro game add-ons.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a RomM server (5.0 or newer) that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the RomM project.
extension.news: v0.3.3 - Jump to letter at the top of long lists sorted by name v0.3.2 - Game lists open at once; their backgrounds are made in the background and appear within moments v0.3.1 - Game backgrounds get a CRT look, with scanlines and plain as choices (Screenshot look, under Library) - A whole page's backgrounds are made at once, and console screenshots are shown 4:3 as on a TV v0.3.0 - Game backgrounds show the whole screenshot, sharp, on a blurred copy of itself, instead of a crop v0.2.11 - Tile names are drawn properly with the Estuary skin's font v0.2.10 - Favourites that showed a tile go back to the RomM icon by themselves, keeping their place v0.2.9 - Tiles stay on the menu: RomM favourites no longer get one, so pick a thumbnail again for any that did - Kodi quits promptly even with a request under way v0.2.8 - The shadow behind two-line tile names sits on both lines v0.2.7 - Bigger tile names; long ones wrap onto two lines - Tiles are redrawn right after an update v0.2.6 - Menu entries and RomM favourites show a game picture with their name, new each day (setting under Library) v0.2.5 - Downloads and unpacking cut short are redone instead of used half-finished - BIOS files are copied even when the server does not give their size - Clearer errors when the server drops the connection - Stop now cancels pairing - File names from the server stay inside the download folder
